senses.gloss: m. pl. (פָּסַס, v. פַּס II) [distributions, cmp. Lat. tributum,] taxes, esp. pissim, pissin, name of a Roman tax laid on the community and distributed by the latter according to assessments (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Vectigalia).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:18">Y. Peah I, 15ᵇ</cite> bot. (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 3:26">Prov. III, 26</cite>) <he>אם נתת … משמרך מן הפ׳ וכ׳</he> if thou givest charity out of thy pocket (voluntarily), the Lord will guard thee from tributes, fines &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 1">Gen. R. s. 1</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 4:10:4">Y. Ab. Zar. IV, 44ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:3:3">Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ</cite> <he>אתם מגלגלין עלינו פ׳ וזימיות וכ׳</he> you impose upon us tributes and fines &c.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 312:1">Yalk. Jer. 312</cite> <he>משתעבדין … בפ׳ ובהוניות וכ׳</he> are oppressed by tributes, confiscations &c.; Pesik. Baḥod. p. 151ᵃ <he>במסים</he> (corr. acc.); a. fr.
